items.title: Shipwreck Off Senegal Kills Dozens as Canary Islands Declare Migrant Emergency
items.summary: Migrant arrivals to Europe are down overall but still claiming scores of victims, overwhelming local officials and dominating political debate.

items.title: France Blames Iran for Cyberattack on Refrigeration Systems

items.summary: U.S.-led talks to end the war between Russia and Ukraine will resume this week in Abu Dhabi. A cease-fire won’t be on the table.

items.title: Germans Miss Merkel, Their Old Chancellor, Though They Dislike Her Policies

items.title: Suspect in Mass Shooting in Krakow, Poland, Dies in Hospital. Here’s What to Know.
items.summary: At least nine people were dead after shootings in Krakow and another town. The suspected gunman died in the hospital and his motive remains unclear.

items.title: China’s Trade Surplus Passes $1 Trillion at Record Pace

items.title: Exxon Strikes Preliminary Deal to Return to Venezuela
